provenance.aggregation_rule: Per drug x target: ChEMBL activities with standard_type=Ki, target_organism=Homo sapiens, target a ChEMBL SINGLE PROTEIN resolved from the panel's UniProt accession, standard_relation='=', standard_units='nM', pchembl_value present, no data_validity_comment, not potential_duplicate. pChEMBL values are grouped by document_chembl_id, averaged within each document, and pki_median is the median of those per-document means. ki_nM = 10**(9-pki_median). ki_min_nM/ki_max_nM are the extremes of the individual measurements.
provenance.gtopdb: not queried in this build; ChEMBL only (see module docstring).
provenance.held_out_note: Binding is a model input, not a held-out outcome (pipeline/guards.py V2_TRUTH / v2_heldout); no held-out membership is recorded in this file.
provenance.kd_handling: Kd rows (same filters, standard_type=Kd) are kept separate under kd_only for drug x target pairs with no qualifying Ki, and are never merged into the Ki aggregate.
provenance.no_data_handling: A drug x target pair with zero qualifying Ki rows is listed by gene in that drug's searched_and_empty array; it is never imputed or omitted silently.
